en.html:
Cannon"Right... Everything ready for the drop?"
GHQ Lieutenant"Yes, sir. No problem. The carrier is already armed and waiting at the launch port."
Cannon"Good."
GHQ Lieutenant"...Lieutenant Colonel Cannon."
Cannon"What is it?"
GHQ Lieutenant"Will we achieve what we came for, sir?"
Cannon"..."
Cannon"Yes. We will do it, Lieutenant Gargett."
Cannon"Take Yamato. Fight the Queen. Free our homeland. For our people waiting on that vast continent."
GHQ Lieutenant"..."
Cannon"And for our people who are no longer waiting anywhere. Major General Willow... Major Gargett."
Cannon"Your elder brother died bravely, Lieutenant. We have to give that death an answer."
GHQ Lieutenant"...Yes."

en.html:
Cannon"Professor..."
Wolf"Come. Time to drop the Forged Bomb. Give the order."
Cannon"...I am not doing slapstick comedy with you."
Wolf"Neither am I."
Cannon"On our own men's HEADS, you want me to drop it?"
Wolf"A necessary sacrifice."
Cannon"For a discussion we've barely had, 'necessary' is a very confident word."
Wolf"Is it? Let us have it, then."
Wolf"Use the Forged Bomb now: Rokuhara annihilated. Yamato's people submit to us in fear. We obtain our base for challenging the British Commonwealth."
Wolf"Now is the opportunity. When the next one comes, who can say?"
Wolf"There. Where is the room for debate?"
Cannon"..."
Wolf"Lieutenant Colonel, you know what must be done. Why waste time manufacturing difficulty?"
Cannon"Unlike you, Professor, I am an ordinary man. Truth on this side, falsehood on that side—I cannot divide everything so smartly."
Wolf"Normally, yes, think it over. Worry away. Grind your thoughts until the answer comes out to your satisfaction. But NOW is the time to decide."
Wolf"A military man understands this, surely."
Cannon"...Unfortunately, 'Should I bomb my own men to achieve my objective?' is a first-time problem for me."
Wolf"There are no men of ours down there. That is the League army. The Commonwealth's servants, no?"
Cannon"Our compatriots are among them."
Wolf"NECESSARY SACRIFICE! A man of your intelligence, and still I have to explain!"
Cannon"..."

キャノン「教授……」
ウォルフ「さ、鍛造雷弾を投下する時だ。 　発令したまえ」
キャノン「……スラップスティックコメディをやる気 はありませんよ」
ウォルフ「僕にもないね」
キャノン「味方の頭の上に爆弾を落とせと？」
ウォルフ「必要な犠牲だ」
キャノン「必要と言い切るには、議論が足りていない と思いますが」
ウォルフ「そうかな？ 　試してみようか」
ウォルフ「いま鍛造雷弾を使えば六波羅を撃滅できる。 　大和の民は我々に畏服し、我々は大英連邦 に挑む足場を獲得する」
ウォルフ「今が好機。 　次の機会はいつやって来るかわからない」
ウォルフ「――さて。 　論議の余地があるかな？」
キャノン「…………」
ウォルフ「中佐、するべき事はわかっているはずだよ。 　無駄な時間を費やすのは止そうじゃないか」
キャノン「私はあなたと違って凡人なんです。 　そう簡単には真実とそうでないものを割り 切れませんよ」
ウォルフ「普段なら悩むのもいい。納得のゆく結論が 出るまで考え抜くのもいい。 　しかし今は決断の時なのだ」
ウォルフ「軍人ならわかるだろう」
キャノン「……生憎、戦場で味方を爆撃してでも目的 達成に固執するべきなのかという問題に取り 組むのはこれが初めてでして」
ウォルフ「地上に我々の味方などいない。 　あれは連盟軍。大英連邦の手先だよ。そう ではないか？」
キャノン「その中に、同胞・・もいるんですよ」
ウォルフ「必要な犠牲だ！ 　わからないのか、君ほどの男が！」
キャノン「…………」

Wolf"Taking off a ridiculous ceremonial hat gives SUPREME relief! But to enjoy that relief, first you must suffer the wearing of the bloody hat! THIS is the principle!"
Cannon"Now I understand even less."
Wolf"Uff, what a difficult man! Have you already forgotten how Major General Willow died, Lieutenant Colonel?!"
Cannon"..."
Wolf"His last wish also forgotten? He was counting on YOU, was he not!"
Wolf"You will trample on the thing he wanted most?!"
Cannon"Professor Wolf."
Wolf"One thing only remains for you to do. Give the order! NOW!"

en.html:
Wolf"..."
Cannon"..."
Wolf"A lovely lighter. But I don't smoke."
Cannon"Very healthy. Please continue with this healthy attitude."
Cannon"This lovely lighter, one small mistake in its use... and the result becomes very unhealthy indeed."
Wolf"..."
Cannon"If you insist... Yes. If you absolutely INSIST..."
Cannon"...that I drop the Forged Bomb, first tell me your real reason. That is the proper order of doing things, no?"
Wolf"What are you asking at this stage? Everything is to bring the hammer down on the Commonwealth's arrogant rule—"
Cannon"Professor."
Cannon"I will ask the same question once more. If the answer remains the same... I regret that your good health will have to suffer. So think carefully before answering."
Wolf"..."
Cannon"You have insisted on using the Forged Bomb. Not victory. Not military results. Not political significance. Just that one act: drop the bomb on Fudaraku."
Cannon"For that, you came to us."
Wolf"Cannon, my dear fellow... some misunderstanding here—"
Cannon"Professor Wolf. Do you remember..."
Cannon"...our conversation in Yokohama, before the war?"
Wolf"...?"

Cannon"No. We may even fail to win. Not necessarily lose, but fail to destroy the enemy's main force quickly, as planned."
Wolf"A difficult battle, you mean?"
Cannon"Yes."
Willow"That is so..."
Wolf"How convenient, then."
Cannon"...Excuse me?"
Wolf"If the situation turns against us, that becomes our reason to request permission for the Forged Bomb. Headquarters will presumably prefer the easier option to sending major reinforcements."
Cannon"...Professor. Is this not becoming a little too reckless?"
Willow"No... no! Don't decide that so quickly, Lieutenant Colonel Cannon."

en.html:
Cannon"At that time, you said—'How convenient.'"
Cannon"...Convenient for whom, exactly? We chose to invade Kanto with conventional forces. For us, the best result was a smooth operation: take Fudaraku with the fewest possible losses."
Cannon"Getting into such difficulty that we are FORCED to use the Forged Bomb—that is convenience? For us?"
Wolf"————————"
Cannon"For YOU, personally, it is convenient. Isn't that so, Professor?"
Cannon"For some reason, you absolutely must use that bomb. So our difficulties are exactly what you want. Did you put in some hard work to bring them about?"
Cannon"Passing information to Rokuhara, for example..."
Wolf"..."
Cannon"Now answer me. Professor Wolf. What are you trying to achieve?"
Wolf"..."
Cannon"..."
GHQ Lieutenant"To receive the Last Judgment, Lieutenant Colonel Cannon."

Cannon"You're with Professor Wolf?"

Wolf"Fellow seekers of truth, one might say."
GHQ Lieutenant"...No. Not that. This officer—arre, leave it. I am tired. That's all."
GHQ Lieutenant"I am TIRED, Lieutenant Colonel Cannon."
Cannon"Lieutenant..."
GHQ Lieutenant"We occupy Yamato. Then what? An endless war against the British Commonwealth, isn't it?"

Cannon"So you give up on freeing our homeland?"
Cannon"Money? Something else? I don't know what he's paying. You sell your pride and your comrades to this suspicious bearded fellow, then spend the rest of your life in peace?"
GHQ Lieutenant"..."

en.html:
Cannon"George's younger brother. I expected a little more spirit from you... Never imagined you were genuinely willing to bow before the Queen."
GHQ Lieutenant"Don't think so little of me. I will not bow to her."
Cannon"But you'll stop fighting and run away to some southern island?"
GHQ Lieutenant"No. I will fight."
GHQ Lieutenant"The British Commonwealth WILL receive its judgment."
Cannon"Excellent. In how many hundred years?"
GHQ Lieutenant"Today."
Cannon"..."
GHQ Lieutenant"..."
Cannon"You said something about the Last Judgment."
GHQ Lieutenant"Yes."
Cannon"These jokes of you youngsters, I don't keep up. Explain so this uncle can understand also."
GHQ Lieutenant"I can. But first, drop the Forged Bomb. You worked it out correctly. That is what we want."
Cannon"Why don't you do it yourself? Busy playing pistol-against-your-superior's-head, I see. Unfortunately, I'm playing the same game with our academic adviser."
GHQ Lieutenant"Sir...!"
Wolf"We are calling God."

キャノン「あのジョージの弟だ。もう少し気概はある とみていたんだがな……。 　まさか女王に本心から屈服しても構わない と思っているとはね」
Ｇ中尉「見縊らないで欲しい。 　女王に頭を下げたりはしません」
キャノン「だが戦うのはやめて、どこか南の島にでも 逃げたりはするのか？」
Ｇ中尉「いいえ。 　戦いますとも」
Ｇ中尉「大英連邦に裁きは与えますとも」
キャノン「それは素晴らしい。何百年後にだい？」
Ｇ中尉「今日のうちに」
キャノン「…………」
Ｇ中尉「……」
キャノン「最後の審判とか言ったな」
Ｇ中尉「ええ」
キャノン「最近の若者のジョークには疎くてね。 　おじさんにもわかるように説明してもらえ ないか」
Ｇ中尉「構いませんがまず、鍛造雷弾の投下を。 　ご明察の通り、我々はそれを求めているの です」
キャノン「自分でやったらどうだ？ 　見たところ上官の頭に銃を押し付ける遊び で忙しいようだが、実は俺も学術顧問を相手 に同じ遊びの最中でね」
Ｇ中尉「中佐……！」
ウォルフ「神を呼ぶのだよ」

en.html:
Cannon"...Professor? What did you say?"
Wolf"Calling God. Into our world."
Wolf"Before God, every falsehood is stripped away. Humanity must expose its sins, its karma... the whole truth. And its worth will be judged. Positive or negative, whatever the result."
Cannon"...The God I know is a lazy fellow. Not in the habit of appearing before people, as I understand it."
Wolf"Yes. These past thousands of years, he has done nothing but sleep in his underground bedroom. Snoring loudly. We wish to worship him as our great Father; the example he is setting, frankly, is not ideal."
Wolf"Time for him to smarten up a little. First we knock him out of bed. Then outside, into the sunshine. Utho, Papa. Enough sleeping."
Cannon"..."
Cannon"I hope I have misunderstood."
Wolf"Hm?"
Cannon"You mean to bring an ACTUALLY EXISTING God onto the earth?"
Wolf"Yes. Exactly."
Cannon"........................"
Wolf"For that, we ring one exceptionally large bell. The Forged Bomb."
Cannon"Sorry, Professor. Not one bloody thing of this do I understand."
Wolf"Truth exists beyond human understanding also. That is the point."
Cannon"The mystic's standard answer."
Wolf"Don't use that phrase to switch off your brain. Think, and then acknowledge what is there."
Cannon"Ah. This underground God of yours?"
Wolf"Yes. Lieutenant Gargett's betrayal—you overlooked it all this time, and now, finally, you accept it as fact, don't you?"
Wolf"Same thing."
Cannon"..."

キャノン「…………教授？ 　何と言われました？」
ウォルフ「神を呼ぶのだ。 　我々の世界に」
ウォルフ「神の前ではあらゆる虚偽が剥ぎ取られる。 　人類はその罪を、業を……すべての真実を さらけ出し、正にせよ負にせよ、価値を定め られることになるだろう」
キャノン「…………。 　私の知っている神様というやつは怠け者で、 なかなか人間の前には姿を見せて下さらない はずなんですがね」
ウォルフ「うむ。神はこの数千年、地底の寝室で寝て ばかりだ。高鼾たかいびきでね。 　神を大いなる父として崇め奉りたい我々に とって、あまり理想的なお姿とはいえない」
ウォルフ「そろそろシャキッとして頂こうと思うのだ。 　まずは寝床から叩き起こし、外に出て日光 を浴びてもらわねば」
キャノン「…………」
キャノン「誤解だといいのですが」
ウォルフ「うむ？」
キャノン「あなたはもしかして、実在する・・・・神を地上へ 降ろすと言いたいのですか？」
ウォルフ「ああ、そうだ」
キャノン「……………………」
ウォルフ「そのために鍛造雷弾という特大の鐘を打ち 鳴らすのだよ」
キャノン「申し訳ありませんが、教授。 　全く理解できません」
ウォルフ「人知の理解を超える所にも真実はある。 　そういうことだ」
キャノン「神秘主義者の常套句ですな」
ウォルフ「その一言で思考停止するべきではない。 　君は考え、そして認めた方がいい」
キャノン「はぁ。地底の神とやらを？」
ウォルフ「うん。 　君はずっと見過ごしていたガーゲット中尉 の背信を、今ようやく事実として認めている だろう？」
ウォルフ「それと同じことさ」
キャノン「…………」

Wolf"You are among the sharpest people I know. Ah, you remind me of Heydrich..."
Wolf"But perfect intelligence, no. Even SS General Reinhard Heydrich was not perfect. He fell to terrorism."
Cannon"What are you getting at?"
Wolf"Truths you haven't noticed. ...You think Lieutenant Gargett is the only one?"
Cannon"————"
Wolf"You secretly placed your new-continent independence comrades throughout GHQ and took control, didn't you? If I have done the same thing, why should that be surprising?"
Cannon"What did you say...?"
Wolf"Of course, easy it was not. But after the death of the lieutenant's brother—Major George Gargett—even you became less careful about what was happening under your feet."
Wolf"Through that gap, MY people entered. Into YOUR organisation."
Cannon"..."
Wolf"Not a large number. But enough to do what is needed, when it is needed."
Wolf"On this ship also."
Wolf"Enough to take control of its functions right now. For just as long as required..."

ウォルフ「君は僕の知る中で最も明敏な人物の一人だ。 　ああ、ハイドリヒ君を思い出すよ……」
ウォルフ「しかし完璧な知性の所有者ではない。 　かの親衛隊ＳＳ大将ラインハルト・ハイドリヒ もやはり完璧ではなく、テロに斃れたように」
キャノン「何が仰りたいので？」

キャノン「――――」
ウォルフ「君はＧＨＱの各部署へ新大陸独立派の仲間 を密かに送り込み、権限を掌握しただろう？ 　同じことを僕がやっていたとしたら不思議 かな？」
キャノン「何ですと……」
ウォルフ「もちろん簡単ではなかったがね。 　しかし中尉の兄――ジョージ・ガーゲット 少佐の死後は、さしもの君も足元への注意が それまでよりおろそかになった」
ウォルフ「その隙に僕の仲間・・・・が潜り込んだ。 　君の組織の中に」

ウォルフ「この船の中にも・・・・・・・」
ウォルフ「今この時、必要な間だけ、船の機能を奪い 取れる程度の数は……」

Cannon"........................"
Wolf"Now. Lieutenant Colonel Cannon."
Wolf"I will ask questions and make a request. Answer yes or no."
Cannon"...Go ahead."
Wolf"You overlooked many important things."
Cannon"Yes."
Wolf"You were not perfect."
Cannon"Yes."
Wolf"You have lost."
Cannon"...Yes..."
Wolf"Then will you cooperate with us?"
Cannon"No."
Wolf"..."
Cannon"Professor, I have lost. That does not make you people winners."
Wolf"Why not?"
Cannon"An ordinary observation only."
Cannon"People have won while praying to God, respecting God, knowing nothing of God, even abusing God. But those who CLING to God are always losers."
GHQ Lieutenant"...Ngh..."
Wolf"I see..."
Cannon"Professor Wolf. One last thing from my side, if I may."
Cannon"For a long time now, I've been wanting very badly to say this..."
Wolf"What is it?"
Cannon"You bloody madman."
Wolf"Ja."

ja.html:
キャノン「…………………………」
ウォルフ「さて。 　キャノン中佐」
ウォルフ「僕はこれから、質問と要求をする。 　是イエスか否ノーで答えてもらおう」
キャノン「……どうぞ」
ウォルフ「君は多くの、大切なことを見落とした」
キャノン「是イエス」
ウォルフ「君は完璧ではなかった」
キャノン「是イエス」
ウォルフ「君は敗北した」
キャノン「……是イエス……」
ウォルフ「では、我々に協力してくれるかな？」
キャノン「否ノー」
ウォルフ「…………」
キャノン「教授、私は敗者です。 　そしてあなた方は勝者ではない」
ウォルフ「何故かな？」
キャノン「単なる一般論ですよ」
キャノン「神に祈る者、神を敬う者、神を知らぬ者、 神を罵る者が勝者になった例はある。 　しかし、神に縋る・・者は常に敗者だ」
Ｇ中尉「……っ……」
ウォルフ「そうか……」
キャノン「ウォルフ教授。 　私からも最後に一つ、構いませんか」
キャノン「これまでずっと言いたくてたまらなかった ことがあって……」
ウォルフ「何だい？」
キャノン「この狂人が」
ウォルフ「是ヤー」
